name: SimpleTrade
summary: SimpleTrade is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossover signals to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It opens positions when a fast moving average crosses above or below a slow moving average, with basic stop loss and take profit management. The EA is designed for simplicity and operates on a single timeframe without complex filtering conditions.
summary_zh: SimpleTrade是一个基于均线交叉信号的趋势跟踪EA，在快速均线与慢速均线交叉时顺势开仓。它设置了基本的止损和止盈管理，设计简洁，在单一时间周期上运行，没有复杂的过滤条件。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线交叉策略作为核心交易逻辑，当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时做多，向下穿越时做空。入场条件仅依赖均线交叉信号，缺少额外的趋势确认过滤器，容易在震荡行情中产生虚假信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，没有移动止损或追踪止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面仅设置了止损点数，未考虑最大回撤限制或单笔最大亏损比例控制。整体策略设计简单直观，但缺乏对市场状态（趋势/震荡）的识别能力，在区间行情中容易频繁亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average crossover strategy as its core trading logic, going long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and going short on the opposite crossover. Entry conditions rely solely on the MA crossover signal without additional trend confirmation filters, making it susceptible to false signals during ranging markets. Exit conditions depend on fixed pip-based stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is limited to setting a stop loss distance in pips, without maximum drawdown limits or per-trade risk percentage controls. The overall strategy design is simple and intuitive but lacks market state identification (trend vs. range), leading to frequent losses during sideways market conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和验证
趋势行情中能够有效捕捉中长期方向性机会
参数较少，优化和回测成本低
固定止损止盈提供了基本的风险控制框架
代码简洁，便于二次开发和功能扩展
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and verify
Effectively captures medium-to-long-term directional opportunities in trending markets
Few parameters result in low optimization and backtesting costs
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide a basic risk control framework
Clean codebase makes it easy for further development and feature extension
cons: 缺乏市场状态识别，震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数不根据账户风险动态调整，资金管理粗糙
没有移动止损机制，盈利单可能大幅回吐
仅依赖均线交叉单一指标，缺少多维度确认信号
未考虑点差和滑点对短线交易的影响
cons_en: Lacks market state identification, generating frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot size does not dynamically adjust based on account risk, resulting in crude money management
No trailing stop mechanism means profitable trades can give back significant gains
Relies solely on MA crossover as a single indicator without multi-dimensional signal confirmation
Does not account for spread and slippage impact on short-term trades
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中抑制交易信号
引入基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位计算，使风险管理适应市场波动
添加移动止损功能，在盈利达到一定阈值后自动追踪保护利润
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to suppress trading signals during ranging market conditions
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and position sizing to adapt risk management to market volatility
Add trailing stop functionality to automatically protect profits once a gain threshold is reached

risk_points: 均线交叉在震荡市中频繁触发虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数不根据账户净值调整，大额亏损时风险暴露过大
缺少最大持仓和最大回撤限制
risk_points_en: MA crossover frequently triggers false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account equity, creating excessive risk exposure during large drawdowns
No maximum position limit or maximum drawdown control

It opens positions when a fast moving average crosses above or below a slow moving average, with basic stop loss and take profit management. The EA is designed for simplicity and operates on a single timeframe without complex filtering conditions.
